a.xlink:title: Base class for conditional jump (JMP_*) op-codes.
JMP_EQ rvalue1, rvalue2, addr ; jump if value1 is equal to value2.
JMP_FALSE rvalue, addr ; jump if value is Boolean.False.
JMP_GT rvalue1, rvalue2, addr ; jump if value1 is greater than value2.
JMP_GTE rvalue1, rvalue2, addr ; jump if value is greater than or equal than value2.
JMP_LT rvalue1, rvalue2, addr ; jump if value1 is less than value2.
JMP_LTE rvalue1, rvalue2, addr ; jump if value1 is less than or equal than value2.
OP_JMP_NSAMPLE inverse-sample-rate, addr ; jump if this is NOT a selected sample based on the ; rvalu...
JMP_NTYPE rvalue, rvalue-type, addr ; jump if type of the value is NOT "instanceof" specified type.
JMP_NEQ rvalue1, rvalue2, addr ; jump if value1 is NOT equal to value2.
JMP_NNULL rvalue, addr ; jump if value is NOT null.
JMP_NZERO rvalue, addr ; jump if value is NOT zero.
JMP_NULL rvalue, addr ; jump if value is null.
JMP_TRUE rvalue, addr ; jump if value is Boolean.True.
JMP_TYPE rvalue, rvalue-type, addr ; jump if type of the value is "instanceof" specified type.
JMP_ZERO rvalue, addr ; jump if value is zero.
Base class for all XVM machine code instructions, each of which is called an "op".
